title: Azimut Grande 95 RPH
highlights: Raised pilothouse layout with full-beam main-deck master
Five cabins for up to 10 guests
Flybridge with Jacuzzi, bar and 600 kg crane
description:
This 2014 Azimut Grande 95 RPH combines a raised pilothouse, for superior visibility from the helm, with an impressive five-cabin layout for up to ten guests. The full-beam master suite sits on the main deck, with four further guest cabins below.

Designed by Stefano Righini, she features floor-to-ceiling saloon windows and a flybridge with Jacuzzi, full bar, dining area and sunpad, plus a 600 kg crane and a garage for water toys. Twin MTU engines with 754 hours give a cruising speed of around 20 knots. She is available for viewing in Hong Kong.
